summary: Stay in the game by keeping Gold above 0 and Alcohol Content below Fortitude; last remaining player wins.
Start at Fortitude 20 and Alcohol Content 0.
Normally 10 Gold; 2-player games use 8; games with 7+ players use 12.
Shuffle character deck and draw 7 cards.
Each player begins with 1 face-down card in their Drink Me! pile.
Turn order is Discard & Draw → Action → Order a Drink → Drink.
You may discard unwanted cards, then draw until you hold 7. If already at 7+, you may keep them and draw none.
You may play one Action card. Gambling-starting Action cards suspend normal play for a gambling round.
Place the top Drink Deck card face down on another player's Drink Me! pile.
Reveal the top card of your Drink Me! pile and resolve it. If the pile is empty, reduce Alcohol Content by 1 instead.
Sometimes cards are reactions usable only when their printed condition is met; multiple reactions may be played sequentially.
Anytime cards may be played at any time, including to interrupt another action, subject to timing rules.

Negate cancels a card/effect according to the applicable response rules; Ignore protects the affected player/effect target rather than necessarily canceling the source for everyone. Model these as separate engine operations.
A player with 0 Gold is eliminated after currently resolving effects and final response opportunities are completed.
A player passes out when Alcohol Content is greater than or equal to Fortitude. Their Gold is split: half rounded up to the Inn, remainder evenly among surviving players, remainder to Inn.
Resolve pass-outs and Gold redistribution before checking other zero-Gold eliminations; if all remaining players lose simultaneously, they tie.
A Gambling-starting Action begins a round; participating players ante 1 Gold and the initiator begins in control.
Players proceed clockwise; on their gambling turn they may play a Gambling/Cheating card or pass.
Playing a Gambling or Cheating card normally gives control of the round; Winning Hand requires a Cheating card to take control from it.
When everyone except the controller passes, the controller wins the pot. Explicit 'win the round' effects end it immediately.
A player who leaves cannot play further Gambling/Cheating cards that round but may still use Sometimes/Anytime cards; their existing ante stays in the pot.
When the Drink Deck runs out, each player pays 1 Gold to the Inn, then the discard pile is shuffled into a new Drink Deck.
Drink Event cards resolve their event instructions and are not affected by ordinary Drink modifiers unless specifically allowed.
A Drink with a Chaser reveals another card from the same source; Drink chasers combine into a single Drink. Drink Events revealed as chasers are discarded without their event effect.
Fortitude and Alcohol Content are bounded 0–20; Gold cannot go below 0 and has no fixed maximum.
